user_query: I'm organizing a party and I want to create a playlist with songs from a specific artist. Can you recommend the top tracks of an artist from Shazam and Deezer? The playlist should have a mix of popular and lesser-known songs.

TaskList.description: Retrieve top tracks of the specified artist from Shazam, focusing on both popular and lesser-known songs.
Retrieve top tracks of the specified artist from Deezer, ensuring a balance between popular and lesser-known tracks.
Combine the track lists obtained from Shazam and Deezer into a single unified playlist.
Finalize the playlist by selecting the best mix of popular and lesser-known songs from the combined list.
